scope: Engineering development after original fresh/historical confirmation and scalar timing results were inspected. Existing eight validation slices/four parents only; not new confirmation, student preregistration, novel theory or a held-out selection. No model learning, recalibration, new data or old fresh/historical outcomes loaded by this runner.

prior_known_context.scope: Rounded completed scalar benchmark context supplied by root, not newly measured or used as new batching outcomes. Existing scalar validation/gate and profile outcomes were already inspected.

parity_before_timing.scalar64_scope: Additional untimed parity-only reference, not a seventh timed control. Its actual work is reported separately.
parity_before_timing.checks: Aggregate/block objectives and gradients, state/adjoint fields, directions, residual and error components, centers/bounds/terms, context identity, availability/certification/fallback decisions; no comparative timing starts unless every comparison passes.
parity_before_timing.reference: Independent exact 24-block objective/gradients on a separate fine solver; stored exact aggregate teacher labels checked first. All fine/reduced/coarse preflight work and setup are paid separately.

timing.method_order: Repetition outermost, then eight fixed cases; rotate six METHODS by (repetition + case_index) modulo 6. Each method occupies every position once per case.
timing.cache_rule: New independent physics/POD/coarse/certifier objects for every method/case/repetition; no cross-call model/factor/mass/receiver caches; within-survey caching remains as existing APIs.
timing.clock: time.perf_counter; three adjacent timestamps: constructor setup, complete current-model query, total cold. Receipts/quality/output/teardown outside core timing.
timing.paid_work: Include constructor basis copy/orthogonality Gram/projected operators and damping DCTs; all current-model mass/factor/solve/lift work, model DCTs, coarse inverse identity RHS, receiver constants, corrections, actual residuals/projections/norms and complete certificate construction.
timing.different_tasks: Exact discrete objective/full gradient; raw approximate POD objective/gradient; corrected physical proposal plus directional bound. No equal-accuracy, inversion, time-to-target, field-scale or RHS-count-derived speedup claim.
timing.idle_rule: No actual evaluation/timing until source/protocol review and explicit root GO with all task-owned compute idle. Single-process solver-cold, not process/OS/CPU-cache cold; record observed load and caller context.
timing.dispatch_rule: Preserve actual fine/reduced/coarse RHS-column counters and factor/projection/lift/real-equivalent transform counts; report actual new batch dispatch counters separately. These dimensions/operation units are not interchangeable FLOPs.

candidate_rule.eligibility: Every one of all eight validation slices must have an available strict descent certificate; all aggregate and all 24 block bounds must cover independent exact derivatives. All parity and repeat checks must pass. Every failure/abstention remains in the cohort.
candidate_rule.cost_score: For each slice take the median of six total cold setup+query wall times; average slice medians within each parent, then average the four parent means.
candidate_rule.choice: Recommend only the lowest-score eligible candidate; exact-score ties prefer rank96. If neither qualifies, retain existing coarse96 with no performance claim. This is a development recommendation only, never automatic deployment or held-out selection.
candidate_rule.future_use: Root must explicitly freeze any chosen variant and new evaluation protocol before any additional held-out outcomes; no old fresh/historical reevaluation in this study.

numeric_rules.nonfinite: Retain completed rows/raw diagnostics and costs, mark failed/incomplete or checks-failed; do not clip, drop cases, treat repeated missing proposals as successful parity, or emit nonfinite JSON certificates.
numeric_rules.unavailability: Keep finite raw/mixed proposals with null unavailable bounds and exact-fallback-required; no online exact recovery. All six controls and all slices remain reported.

reporting.statistical_scope: Descriptive existing eight correlated slices/four parents, revisited six times. Equal-parent summaries; repetitions and blocks are not additional geological samples. No IID-eight or simultaneous intervals.
reporting.numerical_scope: Ordinary float64/complex128; exact-arithmetic residual inequalities with unverified floating-point cancellation allowance, not formal roundoff enclosure or corrected-state autograd identity.
reporting.offline_costs: Retain historical teacher/basis fit provenance plus current independent exact verification and all untimed scalar/batch parity work, setup and dispatched work; no free precomputation.
reporting.artifacts: Protocol/source/runtime/input hashes, all preflight parity metrics and costs, all 288 cold calls and 48 paired six-method rows, all 6912 block quality rows, current contexts/counters/aggregate vectors, all candidate eligibility/costs and explicit development choice.
